ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:1 ratio of high-intensity white central pixels to low-intensity black/dark grey peripheral pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions occupy the inner lobes, transitioning to a well-defined dark border along the trailing edge and lateral tips (Type 2 or 3 pigmentation pattern).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A distinct V-shaped central depression with an internal vertex angle of approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Fine-scale jagged serrations visible along the trailing edge of the right lobe; the left lobe trailing edge is obscured by physical anomalies.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, with a convex trajectory on the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A prominent cluster of 7-10 large, bulbous, brown-toned circular masses (barnacles) located on the mid-to-lower portion of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-parallel vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the white ventral surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization of barnacles on the left lobe, significantly altering the visible edge profile.
